# storage commands

Every `storage` command, with the arguments and options the console actually defines.

## `storage:migrate-metadata`

Move pre-.meta/ object metadata into the reserved metadata subtree.

```bash
bin/semitexa storage:migrate-metadata
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--apply` | no |
| `--remove-legacy` | no |
| `--path` | yes |
